name: Clu J and his Blues Blasters

podcast.title: Early Ska Innovators
podcast.body: In the late 1950s and early 1960s, this band was one of the first to adopt the new offbeat way of playing, contributing to the birth of Ska. Their leader, Cluett Johnson, used the made-up word "Scavuvi" to describe their sound, which some believe is the origin of the term "Ska." "In the late 50s and early 60s, he let a band called Clu J and his blues blasters. And they were one of the first to adopt this new offbeat way of playing."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
